Actual Article Body:
Source:774 ABC Melbourne|Program:Melbourne Drive

Brought to you by

Presented by

774 ABC Melbourne Drive listener Rosemary from Princes Hill has found the two Asylum Seeker Resource Centre catering vans stolen over the AFL Grand Final long weekend.

Rosemary called the program to tell Warwick Long the good news.

Founder and CEO of the Asylum Seeker Resource Centre (ASRC) Kon Karapangiotidis then joined the program to express his elation and thank Rosemary for calling the program.

Press play to hear the full conversation on 774 ABC Melbourne Drive with Warwick Long, filling in for Charlie Pickering.

The Asylum Seeker Resource Centre's casting vans were stolen over the weekend(Supplied: ASRC Facebook)
